data.title: TokenLogic Proposes Aave V4 Bad-Debt Backstop for Core Ethereum Markets
data.description:
TokenLogic has proposed a Sept. 11 plan that would give Aave V4 lenders a bad-debt backstop. The proposal would initially cover only Core WETH, Core USDC and Core USDT on Ethereum.

According to NS3.AI, TokenLogic sized the proposed targets for six to eight weeks of expected loan growth. Under the plan, the DAO would absorb initial losses before volunteer underwriters step in.

data.title: Iranian Media: Two Fishing Boats Hit by Drone Attack Near Strait of Hormuz
data.description: According to Sina Finance, Iranian media said two fishing boats were attacked by enemy drones on Monday evening near Iran's southern Hormozgan province, close to the Strait of Hormuz. Several fishermen on board are missing, and search-and-rescue operations have begun.

data.title: U.S. Central Command Says Iran’s Claim About Panama-Flagged Tanker Hitting Mine Is False
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S. Central Command said the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps' claim that a Panama-flagged tanker recently hit a mine in the Strait of Hormuz was false, and said the tanker Al-Ghayah was hit by an Iranian missile last month and lost the ability to sail. It said Iran again attacked the tanker with drones this weekend while it was anchored in waters off Oman, and that the vessel is now being towed with help from regional partners.

data.title: U.S. Transportation Secretary Duffy Wants to Replace Civil Aviation Radar Before Trump’s Term Ends
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S. Transportation Secretary Duffy said he hopes to replace civil aviation radar equipment before U.S. President Donald Trump’s term ends, and that automation will enter the trucking industry.

data.title: Tema Launches DICE ETF Tied to SpaceX and Prediction Markets
data.description:
Tema ETFs’ Paisley Nardini discussed the Tema Trading & Prediction Markets ETF, ticker DICE, and the Tema Space Innovators ETF, ticker NASA, on Bloomberg ETF IQ, according to Bloomberg.

The interview did not include additional details on the funds’ holdings, launch timing or performance.

data.title: Al Green Plans House Impeachment Vote Against Trump This Week
data.description: According to Axios, Rep. Al Green (D-Texas) said he will force a House impeachment vote against President Trump during the legislative business of Sept. 14-17, prompting sharp criticism from fellow House Democrats who called the move a distraction ahead of the chamber's final week in session before midterm Election Day. Green said the vote would be based on the killings of Renée Good, Alex Pretti, Lorenzo Salgado Araujo and Johan Sebastián Durán Guerrero by federal immigration officers. He has tried to impeach Trump multiple times before, including in 2017, 2018 and twice last year, but those efforts were blocked in bipartisan procedural votes. Some Democrats said they may vote for the measure anyway if Green forces it, while Rep. Shri Thanedar (D-Mich.) said he would support it. House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries (D-N.Y.) has said Democrats have not ruled impeachment in or out.

data.title: U.S. President Donald Trump Defends Iran Policy, Says He Is Open to Talks
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S. President Donald Trump posted multiple messages on social media on the 14th defending his Iran policy, saying he was open to negotiations with Iran and that the U.S. helped transport oil in the Strait of Hormuz, with countries expected to pay the U.S. for escort services.

data.title: BCE Plans Saskatchewan Data Center Expansion to 1.2 Gigawatts
data.description:
BCE Inc. plans to expand its data center campus in Saskatchewan to as much as 1.2 gigawatts of capacity, according to Bloomberg.

The company announced the plan Monday.

data.title: Jack Mallers Says Bitcoin and AI Could Help Humans Regain Time for Creative Work
data.description: Strike CEO Jack Mallers said Bitcoin and artificial intelligence could help humans regain time for creative work. According to NS3.AI, Mallers said hard money rewards time and energy well spent. He also noted that Bitcoin gained about 25% in August and closed the month near $78,000.

data.title: Sysco Seeks $1 Billion Share Sale to Help Fund Jetro Deal
data.description: Sysco Corp. is seeking to raise $1 billion in a share sale to help finance its $29.1 billion acquisition of Jetro Restaurant Depot LLC, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Trump Phones Jensen Huang Live As Nvidia Falls On AI Slowdown Fears
data.description: President Donald Trump phoned Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang live on stage at the All-In Summit and called fears over artificial intelligence a “hoax,” while Huang replied, “You’re right, we’re not going to let that happen sir.” According to BeInCrypto, Nvidia shares still fell, with NVDA trading near $211.81 on Monday afternoon, about 3% below Friday’s close of $218.29, as chip stocks sold off broadly. Intel dropped 7%, Advanced Micro Devices lost 6%, and the iShares Semiconductor ETF slid 6%.

data.title: AMD CEO Lisa Su Sells 125,000 Shares, Regulatory Filing Shows
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, AMD CEO Lisa Su sold 25,000 shares, 35,000 shares (Bonafide gift), and 70,000 shares on September 10, according to newly disclosed regulatory filings.

data.title: VirtualBacon Says Dogecoin Could Reach $1 This Cycle
data.description:
Pseudonymous analyst VirtualBacon said Dogecoin could reach $1 this cycle. According to NS3.AI, that would require roughly 1,090% upside from current levels and imply a market capitalization of about $155.9 billion.

Bitwise also plans to liquidate its Dogecoin ETF, with the fund's last trading day expected Oct. 14.

data.title: AI | Tempus AI Founder Backs Anthropic CEO’s Call to Slow AI Model Development
data.description:
Tempus AI Inc. founder Eric Lefkofsky backed Anthropic PBC Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei’s call to slow the pace of artificial intelligence model development, according to Bloomberg.

Tempus AI is a health technology company that works with virtually all of the world’s major drugmakers.

data.title: Mark Palmer Says Four Factors Are Driving Robinhood Chain's Rapid Growth
data.description:
StoneX analyst Mark Palmer said four factors are driving Robinhood Chain's rapid growth as its total value locked nears $1 billion. According to NS3.AI, daily DEX volume on the chain reached $1.88 billion on Sunday.

The chain's stablecoin market cap recently surpassed $1 billion, adding to signs of expanding activity across the network. Palmer did not provide further details on the four factors in the brief note.

data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, the Bloomberg Electric Vehicle Price Return Index fell 0.65% to 3,299.24 on Monday, after briefly turning positive between 10:00 and 14:00 (UTC+8).

data.title: Churchill Downs Seeks $500 Million Loan Refinance
data.description:
Churchill Downs Inc., the Kentucky Derby operator, is seeking to raise $500 million to refinance existing debt as maturities approach, according to Bloomberg.

The move adds to a rush of companies tapping the market for risky loans.

data.title: FamilyMart To Launch AI-Conceived Dessert This Month
data.description: According to Nikkei Asia, Japanese convenience store chain FamilyMart will launch a dessert conceived by artificial intelligence later this month as part of an effort to use generative AI to develop new products and capture consumer trends.
